claims.claim: Rotifers take 10–40 % of their food as heterotrophic microbes (Arndt 1993; abstract only)
claims.note: full text not obtained. The abstract (not used to confirm) says about 10–40 per cent of rotifers' food 'can consist of heterotrophic organisms of the microbial web' (bacteria, heterotrophic flagellates, ciliates), from feeding experiments and the rotifers' food-size spectrum — a review's estimate of a possible share, not a measured field mean. 'Can' should survive into the text
